assets.title: Durable Execution 状态机

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> RUNNABLE
  RUNNABLE --> RUNNING: worker lease
  RUNNING --> WAITING: timer / signal / approval
  WAITING --> RUNNABLE: event arrives
  RUNNING --> RUNNABLE: retryable failure
  RUNNING --> COMPLETED: durable result
  RUNNING --> CANCELLED: cancellation
  RUNNING --> FAILED: terminal failure
  RUNNING --> RUNNABLE: worker crash / lease expires
  COMPLETED --> [*]
  CANCELLED --> [*]
  FAILED --> [*]

  K -->|low| P
  K -->|high| H[Human / fail closed]
  P --> E[Execute]
